name: Stonefield family
summary: At Stonefield Farm in western Elwynn, the Stonefield family works its land while the Maclure feud endures. Young Tommy Joe is caught across the family divide.

sections.title: Life on the Homestead
sections.body: South of the road to Westfall, the Stonefields work their farm in western Elwynn. Gramma Mildred Stonefield, Ma Stonefield, and young Tommy Joe Stonefield make their home there. They tend crops and livestock, while pests and kobolds from nearby mines and borders trouble the region.

sections.title: The Maclure Feud
sections.body: Woodland and pasture lie between the Stonefield and Maclure farms. The older generations keep a bitter, long-running grudge, and petty squabbles and claims over territory shape their dealings. Yet young Tommy Joe Stonefield and Maybell Maclure have fallen in love. With their families hostile, they depend on discreet travelers to carry messages between them.

faq.q: Where does the Stonefield family live?
faq.answer: The Stonefields live at Stonefield Farm in southwestern Elwynn Forest, just south of the main road toward the Westfall border.

faq.q: Who are the known members of the Stonefield family?
aliases: who is in the stonefield family
faq.answer: The known members of the Stonefield household are Gramma Mildred Stonefield, Ma Stonefield, and young Tommy Joe Stonefield.

faq.q: Why do the Stonefields hate the Maclures?
faq.answer: The Stonefields and Maclures hold old territorial grudges and remain unwilling to reconcile.

faq.q: How does the feud affect Tommy Joe Stonefield?
aliases: who is tommy joe in love with
faq.answer: Tommy Joe Stonefield is in love with Maybell Maclure, whose family is the Stonefields’ rival. They rely on discreet intermediaries to exchange letters and tokens of affection.

faq.q: Is the family aligned with Stormwind?
faq.answer: Yes. As humans in Elwynn Forest, the Stonefields fall under the protection of the Kingdom of Stormwind and the Alliance. Their attention stays on the farm and threats in the region.

faq.q: What threats does the Stonefield family face?
faq.answer: The Stonefields face kobolds, roaming wildlife, too few Stormwind guards in the rural farmlands, and friction with the Maclures.

angles.text: As a human of Stormwind, you can see the Stonefields as part of the working backbone that provides grain and produce for the kingdom.
As an Alliance adventurer traveling toward Westfall, you may find yourself helping the Stonefields with farm chores and family disputes in Elwynn.
